description: Source code for CryptoHalAidl class implementing DRM cryptographic operations using Android AIDL interfaces, including plugin creation, decryption, heap management, and logging.

classes.name: CryptoHalAidl
classes.description: Implementation of DRM cryptographic operations using Android AIDL interfaces, managing plugin lifecycle, decryption, heap buffers, and logging.

methods.name: checkSharedBuffer
methods.description: Validates a shared buffer against internal heap size mappings.

methods.name: isCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given crypto scheme UUID is supported.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a DRM crypto plugin for a specified UUID with optional initialization data.

methods.name: destroyPlugin
methods.description: Destroys the current DRM crypto plugin.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoderComponent
methods.description: Determines if a secure decoder component is required for a given MIME type.

methods.name: notifyResolution
methods.description: Notifies the plugin of video resolution changes.

methods.name: setMediaDrmSession
methods.description: Sets the media DRM session ID.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted media buffers with specified parameters.

methods.name: setHeap
methods.description: Associates a shared memory heap with the DRM plugin.

methods.name: unsetHeap
methods.description: Removes a shared memory heap association from the DRM plugin.
